issues.quote: Do I know? Can I know...
and out of the unknown darkness, so deep and endless, people will not begin to come...
all those who laid into my heart, as into their own hiding place, their hopes, their anger and their suffering, or the bloody cruelty of a beast
All those I cannot get past, who have worn me out...
What is strange in it, if they come once more?
whose blood drained out through a small hole from a soldier's bullet
Another time I ate up the news of a row of white sacks with a ripe plum.
I simply took, you know, a wonderful juicy plum in my fingers
my face is white, like yours, because horror has sucked all the blood out of me
One after another, a second and a third, and so without end.
all of them leave on my soul the prints of their soles
I will stop my ears, lock my soul

strengths.quote: they wrapped you in white sacks, swung you on ropes in the air, and then laid you in poorly covered pits, from which dogs dug you out
You know, I once read how they hanged twelve of you at once... Twelve of you... and I yawned.
and felt a pleasant, sweet taste in my mouth
those living corpses among whom you walk like a bloody phantom
strengths.why: haunting inversion of living and dead

strengths.quote: Can I be sure that the door will not swing open... just a little, with a faint creak
